_comment: NOT A DEPLOYABLE GOVERNANCE FILE. Fixture for test_aTamperedGovernanceFileIsRejectedByTheDigest. It is deploy/expected-governance.json with local-rehearsal's governor swapped for a DIFFERENT, PERFECTLY VALID-LOOKING address -- exactly what pasting the wrong Safe out of a chat window produces. assertDeployable would accept it if the address held a >=2-of-3 Safe, because that is the only thing it checks. The factory address it produces is a DIFFERENT factory address, permanently, and with it every curve and token address arcpad would ever mint. Only the digest separates this file from the real one.
